did: Closed #3155's rest in #3171: askWhileBusy now ends a link that stayed busy (or a read no longer wanted) as busy, never unreachable, and its type makes callers handle it. All 16 call sites in 10 modules (My data, Renders and its status board row, episode notes, feed videos, a cards essay, template preview, clip frames, and soundbites' Takes on home, Needs your attention and Ideas on home) say 'This phone was busy with home just then' in their own words tables. Pages that keep their last read reject with PhoneBusyError from a new build-neutral lib/phone-busy so the last read stays. RO1's Tolerance was removed and the change recorded as a story. Four fresh-context reviews, one per head, caught a cards-essay fold, a resolved-busy regression and a status-board line, all fixed; CI caught the error first living under lib/home-link, which the bundle paths and LA8 forbid.

calls.title: How a read that stays busy is said, and whether a page keeps its last read (C481)
options: say this phone was busy, in one shape with each screen's ending; pages that keep their last read keep it on busy
say this phone was busy; a busy read resolves and replaces what the page last read
say home is busy, as Settings' Sync says of home's own 429
calls.why: The busy is the phone's, not home's, and Sync already says 'Home is busy' for home's own answer; resolving busy would drop the board and notes a drag down had just shown.
calls.undo: Change each surface's busy words in its words table; have readRenders and readHomeNotes resolve busy instead of throwing PhoneBusyError.

left: askHeard still says an unpaired phone and an unparsable 200 as unreachable (#3172).
Home's status codes are still read in about 20 modules (#3156).
The status board's readFailure and phoneWasBusy tests live in home-link's __tests__ rather than beside lib/phone-busy (an optional review nit).
